name: Luena

queries.query: Luena Democratic Republic of the Congo official cadastral parcel map GIS Luena Haut-Lomami Bukama
queries.result: Discovery identified Luena as a locality/rural commune in Bukama Territory, Haut-Lomami. The official Ministry of Land Affairs site provides a current national list of land/cadastral jurisdictions and an official cadastral information bureau viewer, but no Luena parcel-vector service was exposed.

queries.query: Luena Haut-Lomami Bukama cadastre parcelles Ministère des Affaires Foncières RDC
queries.result: La recherche en français confirme Luena comme cité/commune rurale du territoire de Bukama, province du Haut-Lomami. La liste officielle des circonscriptions foncières du Ministère ne liste pour le Haut-Lomami que Kamina et Kanyama; aucune carte publique de parcelles Luena n'a été trouvée.

officialSourceAssessment.nationalCustodian: Ministère des Affaires Foncières de la République démocratique du Congo.
officialSourceAssessment.localAdministrativeEvidence: Official CENI material and Haut-Lomami administrative evidence place Luena in Bukama Territory, Haut-Lomami; this is administrative identification, not proof of an open local parcel service.
officialSourceAssessment.localRegistryCustodian: Not independently evidenced for Luena. The Ministry's current jurisdiction list names Kamina and Kanyama under Haut-Lomami and does not list Luena or Bukama.
officialSourceAssessment.publicViewer: Bureau d'Informations Cadastrales (BIC), bic.cd; its current JavaScript/configuration uses the public Supabase project view cadastral_parcels_public.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official Ministry page loaded anonymously. It lists 143 jurisdictions and lists Haut-Lomami as Kamina and Kanyama only; no Luena/Bukama local cadastral jurisdiction is listed. No parcel geometry or schema is published on this page.
Official CENI source surfaced Luena among Haut-Lomami communes. This supports place identity only and is not a cadastral parcel source.
Public BIC landing page loaded. The page advertises parcel consultation but its current public interface states service availability for Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu, not Haut-Lomami.
Current viewer JavaScript inspected. It references the public Supabase project and loads cadastral search/map chunks; no private token, login, CAPTCHA, or unsafe data request was used.
Anonymous bounded response was an empty array. This is not treated as evidence of citywide absence.
Anonymous bounded coordinate-box response around the preserved WUP point was an empty array. No exact-point or map-extent absence inference was made.
Control request returned one unrelated public sample from Goma, Nord-Kivu. It confirms the view is readable anonymously but does not establish Luena coverage. No control geometry was retained.
